## Full-capability research and discovery

Read the entire current skill, all applicable modes/resources, historical lineage, existing evaluations and adjacent capabilities. Do not use marketing rankings or model-brand folklore as efficacy evidence. Identify what current practice could enable beyond the existing design, not only omissions against its present wording.

## Model suitability and measurement

Determine which model capabilities matter for the whole job: reasoning/decision quality, tools, context, instruction/resource overhead, reliability, latency, raw tokens/cost and operator burden. Verify available runtime/settings with read-only native evidence and current authoritative sources; configured author model, product labels and broad benchmarks are not proof of suitability. Coordinate runtime facts with the shared coordinator workstream, but make the task-specific comparison plan explicit.

Separate skill effects from model/runtime effects. For skill comparisons match model/settings, task/context/tools/starting state and compare bare public task, full incumbent and full trial. Prevent accidental skill loading in bare arms. For model suitability hold skill/task/protocol fixed and change the preregistered model/runtime factor. Use repetitions/blinding appropriate to noise; extra judges are not independent builds. Cover representative major jobs and safe/routing/authority controls; a narrow win does not establish whole-capability benefit.

Candidate authors receive public contracts and permitted aggregate feedback only. Actual independent benchmark producers/judges start without inherited author history and need verified relevant file/tool/MCP/hook/browser/data boundaries. A fresh worktree/task is not proof of isolation. No hidden answers, evaluator labels or credentials may be available to candidates. Existing authored public examples are not held-out validation.

Define score meaning, meaningful gain, hard vetoes, cost/latency/operator limits, repetitions, confirmation and stop conditions before each evaluated candidate. Retain the incumbent on ties/losses; retain confirmed failures and incomplete/charged attempts when an overall comparison is inconclusive. Continue bounded exploration through wins/losses until the declared trial/budget/plateau/target stop, not just the first candidate. No improvement is a valid measured outcome; no valid measurement is inconclusive, not a ceiling claim.
